zh: 如何省視那段披塵沾露的心情
如何揣摩下個驛站里程的願景
en: How to examine that dust-worn, dew-touched state of mind
How to fathom the vision of the next stage's journey

en: If life is a legacy of continual ascent

zh: 如果生活是不斷的塑造和組合
en: If living is ceaseless shaping and recombining

zh: 摺疊出一幅賞心悅目的意象
en: Folding out an image pleasing to the eye
